name: Portals of the Legion
summary: At Mannoroc Coven, six demon portals threaten to widen the flow of demons into this world. Taiga Wisemane asks you to close them from Shadowprey Village.

sections.title: Closing the Gates
sections.body: From Shadowprey Village, Taiga Wisemane gives you the Hand of Iruxos. She says you need to carry it to Mannoroc Coven and banish the portals there. The demon threat is growing, and each portal you close limits how many demons cross into this world. She wants all six banished. Beware their guardians.

faq.answer: The demon portals are at Mannoroc Coven in Desolace.

faq.q: What is needed to banish the portals?
faq.answer: You need the Hand of Iruxos to banish the portals. Taiga Wisemane says you must possess it.

faq.q: Who asks you to banish the portals?
aliases: who gives portals of the legion
faq.answer: Taiga Wisemane asks you to banish the portals from Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: How many portals must be banished?
faq.answer: You must banish six portals at Mannoroc Coven.
Before this, Taiga Wisemane sent you to Thunder Axe Fortress for the Demon Box in Hand of Iruxos.
